packageRules.description: A rust-toolchain bump only rewrites rust-toolchain.toml, but the same version is also pinned in Cargo.toml (rust-version), clippy.toml (msrv) and every dtolnay/rust-toolchain@ entry in .github/workflows. A partial bump silently puts CI on a different toolchain than the one it advertises, so never automerge it - update every location together and let scripts/check_toolchain_pins.py confirm.
